note: Bremer County Conservation park 1 mile east of Plainfield on the Cedar River. Camping is in timber set back from the river, not on the bank; a backwater channel runs ~30-40 m east of the east lane through the trees. Boat ramp and canoe access to the river, 2+ miles of trails, and the North Cedar Wildlife Area adjoining on the west. --Claude
summary: Hookups (30A), facilities (well water, flush + pit toilets, showers, dump), season May 1-Oct 31 and FCFS self-registration confirmed from the county's pages; fees $20 unchanged. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin fine. Stored county URL broken (typo). Note trimmed.
flags: WEBSITE: the stored second line https://www.bremercounty.iowa.gov/government/conservation_board_/campgrounds_parks.php (note the trailing underscore) answers HTTP 500; the county's page is https://www.bremercounty.iowa.gov/government/conservation_board/campgrounds_parks.php. apply.py does not write website.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. No designated sites; the lanes are under closed timber, and the nearest water is a 20-30 m backwater channel ~30-40 m east of the east lane through trees (the main Cedar River channel, ~60-80 m wide, is 100+ m east beyond a wooded island). No official photos of sites exist to show a view, so nothing supports riverview.

FEES: the county lists 'Non-electric - $15/night' beside 'Electrical - 20 and 30 amp - $20/night'; its directory calls the non-electric ones tent sites ('electric and tent camping sites'), so the stored $20 base stands. With no designated sites a motorhome could probably take a non-electric spot for $15, but no page says so.
